title: 7.1 Inverse Variation

icans: I can tell whether x and y show direct variation, inverse variation, or neither.
I can write and use inverse variation equations.
I can use inverse variation to solve real-life problems.

vocab: y = a/x, a ≠ 0: the product xy is ___________

blocks.p: A party has 24 slices of pizza, shared equally. Fill in the table.
Plot the points on graph paper. What stays the same? Write an equation for y: ______________

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Inverse variation: y = _______________, so the _______________ xy is constant.

blocks.stem:
Tell whether x and y show direct variation, inverse variation, or neither.
a.  xy = 5        b.  y = x − 4        c.  3y = 2x        d.  x = 7/y
Tell whether x and y show direct variation, inverse variation, or neither.

notes: Writing an inverse variation: To write an inverse variation equation, find a = _______________, then write y = a/x.

blocks.stem: x and y vary inversely, and y = 6 when x = 4. Write an equation that relates x and y. Then find y when x = 3.
The time t (in hours) it takes to drive a route varies inversely with your speed r (in miles per hour). At 60 miles per hour, the drive takes 3 hours. How long does it take at 45 miles per hour?
x and y vary inversely, and y = −5 when x = 3. Find y when x = −6.
Tell whether x and y show direct variation, inverse variation, or neither. Write an equation if possible.

tickets.stem: Does xy = 10 show direct variation, inverse variation, or neither?
y varies inversely with x, and y = 4 when x = 5. Write an equation.
Use your equation from #2. Find y when x = 8.
